name: RbNO3 phase IV, 296 K before heating
citation: J. Pohl, D. Pohl and G. Adiwidjaja (1992). Phase transition in rubidium nitrate at 346 K and structure at 296, 372, 413 and 437 K. Acta Crystallographica Section B 48, 160-166.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Temperature verified from original publisher first page, not inferred from synthesis or a nominal ambient value. No numerical pressure verified.
method: Experimental single-crystal X-ray diffraction, original 296 K pre-heating structure. The publisher first-page abstract gives the exact matching a=10.474(1), c=7.443(1) A.
synthesis_conditions: Crystals grown from aqueous solution at 290 K, as stated in the original first-page abstract; this is growth temperature, separate from 296 K diffraction.
notes: All three inequivalent Rb sites are retained; parser site order is original Rb3, Rb2, Rb1, each multiplicity3 and population1/3.

The selected twelve-O coordination envelope spans 2.9616-3.6614 A. It includes longer contacts rather than silently reducing the environment to the nearest eight; retain actual distances and do not assume twelve equally strong bonds.
The same paper studies an irreversible transition near346K and multiple post-heating temperatures. This exact cell is the original296K measurement, not a generic nitrate phase.

Raw COD CIF has U_iso_or_equiv=0 placeholders and omits the temperature/DOI tags; the original primary abstract supplies the latter facts. Zero in that exported CIF does not establish zero thermal disorder.
All cell parameters and coordinates are from this exact deposited experimental CIF. No species replacement, generic ideal model, coordinate substitution or cell rescaling.
K edge selected for broad EXAFS reference coverage. A computed FEFF k grid does not establish the usable experimental k range.
Native degeneracy is per absorber. An ensemble of inequivalent sites requires explicit normalized site weights; do not sum all sites at full amplitude.
